newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan oil deliveries fall seven pct in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan oil deliveries fall seven pct in Jan-Sept.

text.p: Oil deliveries to the Moroccan market fell seven percent in the first nine months of this year compared with the same period last year, the Moroccan General Confederation of Business said in its latest bulletin.
Up to the end of September, deliveries this year totalled 4.28 million tonnes against 4.60 million in the same period in 1995.
Deliveries in September fell 17.7 percent to 460,320 tonnes from the previous month, said the bulletin, which gave no August figure.
Most of the September fall resulted from a 44 percent drop in fuel oil and a 16.5 percent decrease in crude, compared with August, it said.
